record.original_question: Prove that for any compact analytic two-dimensional Riemannian manifold with analytic boundary, the set of generalized minimal flows is nonempty and is a proper subset of the Yudovich space.

evidence.quote: Problem 13. Prove that for any two-dimensional compact analytic Riemannian manifold M with analytic boundary the set G M (M ) of generalized minimal flows is a nonempty and proper subset of the Yudovich space Y U (M ).

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a two-dimensional compact analytic Riemannian manifold with analytic boundary. Let $\mathrm{SDiff}(M)$ denote the group of volume-preserving diffeomorphisms of $M$, and consider the space of divergence-free vector fields tangent to $\partial M$. The Yudovich space $YU(M)$ is the space of divergence-free vector fields $u$ on $M$ tangent to $\partial M$ whose vorticity $\operatorname{curl} u$ lies in $L^\infty(M)$. A steady (stationary) solution of the incompressible Euler equation on $M$ is a vector field $u$ such that the pair $(u,p)$ satisfies $\nabla_u u = -\nabla p$ and $\operatorname{div} u = 0$ for some pressure function $p$. A generalized minimal flow on $M$ is, by definition, a vector field $u \in YU(M)$ that minimizes the $L^2$ kinetic energy $\tfrac{1}{2}\int_M |v|^2\,d\mathrm{vol}$ within its coadjoint orbit (equivalently, within the isovortical class consisting of all vector fields obtained from $u$ by the action of measure-preserving homeomorphisms preserving the vorticity distribution), where the minimum is taken over the closure of this orbit inside $YU(M)$. Let $GM(M) \subset YU(M)$ denote the set of all such generalized minimal flows on $M$.

Prove that $GM(M)$ is nonempty and is a proper subset of $YU(M)$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is stated as an open problem (Problem 13) in a 2022/2023 collection of open problems in geometric hydrodynamics by Khesin and Shnirelman (arXiv:2205.01143). No subsequent literature was found resolving the existence and properness of the set of generalized minimal flows in the Yudovich space on 2D compact analytic manifolds with boundary.
